usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only three identity anchors exist (Brazilian-German background, UNDP administrator 2017–2025, Oxford Martin School affiliation). The single retained source is an NPR article about the Israel-Hamas war's economic impact on Palestinian economies, which is unrelated to Achim Steiner and cannot support any biographical content. A reader learns only a bare label — who the person is at headline level (name, nationality, one major role with correct end date, one affiliation) — but nothing about what he actually did, his accomplishments, career history, or current activities. The dossier makes no claims implying completeness, so remainingQuestions is high; the emptiness is at least transparent rather than misleading. With no content beyond anchors, a reader cannot prepare for any meeting; conversationReadiness is 0. The pre-flagged unjustified conclusions ('current-undp' stale-as-current, 'personal-sdgs' team-output-as-personal) do not appear in the dossier text itself, so no overclaims can be matched to cited statements; the 'current-undp' risk is already neutralized by the anchor's correct 2017–2025 end date.
